description_en: Queries the list of nodes that meet the specified conditions in a cluster
description_zh: 您可以调用DescribeClusterNodes接口，查询符合条件的节点列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun cs describe-cluster-nodes --cluster-id c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --instance-ids i-bp11xjhwkj8k966u0000,i-bp1dmhc2bu5igkyq0000 --nodepool-id npe25633140a7d4fbea56cd0479c000000 --state running --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --node-names cn-hangzhou.192.168.0.1 --node-ips 192.168.0.1 --node-labels nodeLabels=app=nginx,env=prod --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterNodes

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of nodes. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点实例ID列表，多值使用英文半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The status of cluster nodes. Used to filter by node running status. Valid values:

`all`: does not filter by running status. All nodes are returned.
`running`: running nodes.
`removing`: nodes that are being removed.
`initial`: nodes that are being initialized.
`failed`: nodes that failed to be created.

Default value: `all`
parameters.help_zh:
集群节点状态，按照集群节点运行状态进行过滤，取值：

`all`：不按照运行状态进行过滤，查询所有状态的节点。
`running`：正在运行的集群节点。
`removing`：正在删除的集群节点。
`initial`：正在初始化的集群节点。
`failed`：创建失败的集群节点。

默认值：`all`
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records that can be displayed on each page. Valid values: [1, 100].

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页可显示的最大记录数。取值范围为[1,100]。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the current query.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前查询的页码数。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

creation_time.description_en: The time when the node was created

error_message.description_en: The error message generated when the node was created

expired_time.description_en: The time when the node expires

image_id.description_en: The ID of the system image used by the node

instance_charge_type.description_en:
The billing method of the node. Valid values:

`PrePaid`: subscription.
`PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go
instance_charge_type.description_zh:
节点付费类型。取值：

`PrePaid`：预付费，包年包月。
`PostPaid`：按量付费

instance_id.description_en: The instance ID of the node

instance_name.description_en: The name of the node in the cluster

instance_role.description_en:
The role type of the node. Valid values:

Master: a master node of the cluster.
Worker: a worker node of the cluster
instance_role.description_zh:
节点角色类型：

Master：集群Master节点。
Worker：集群Worker节点

instance_status.description_en:
The ECS status of the node. Valid values:

`Pending`: being created.
`Running`: running.
`Starting`: being started.
`Stopping`: being stopped.
`Stopped`: stopped
instance_status.description_zh:
节点对应的ECS状态。
`Pending`：创建中。

`Running`：运行中。

`Starting`：启动中。

`Stopping`：停止中。

`Stopped`：已停止

instance_type_family.description_en: The name of the ECS instance family to which the node belongs
instance_type_family.title_zh: 节点实例所属ECS实例簇名称。

ip_address.description_en: The IP addresses of the node

is_aliyun_node.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is an Alibaba Cloud instance. Valid values:

`true`: The node is an Alibaba Cloud instance.

`false`: The node is not an Alibaba Cloud instance
is_aliyun_node.description_zh:
是否为阿里云实例。取值：

`true`：是阿里云实例。

`false`：不是阿里云实例

node_name.description_en: The node name, which is the identifier of the node in the cluster
node_name.description_zh: 节点名称，集群内节点标识
node_name.title_zh: 节点名称，该名称是k8s专用名称。

node_status.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is ready. Valid values:

`Ready`: The node is ready.

`NotReady`: The node is not ready.

`Unknown`: The node status is unknown.

`Offline`: The node is offline
node_status.description_zh:
节点是否就绪。取值：

`Ready`：节点已就绪。

`NotReady`：节点未就绪。

`Unknown`：未知。

`Offline`：离线中

source.description_en: The method used to initialize the node, such as manual creation or Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) creation
source.description_zh: 节点通过何种方式初始化，例如：手动创建或ROS创建
source.title_zh: 节点通过什么方式创建出来的，例如：ROS。

spot_strategy.description_en:
The spot instance type. Valid values:
NoSpot: a non-spot instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a price limit.
SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance priced at the market price at the time of purchase
spot_strategy.description_zh:
抢占式实例类型，取值：
NoSpot：非抢占式实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置抢占实例价格上限。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格

state.description_en:
The running status of the node. Valid values:

`pending`: being created.

`running`: running.

`starting`: being started.

`stopping`: being stopped.

`stopped`: stopped
state.description_zh:
节点运行状态。取值：

`pending`：创建中。

`running`：运行中。

`starting`：启动中。

`stopping`：停止中。

`stopped`：已停止

page_size.description_en: The maximum number of records that can be displayed on each page
page_size.description_zh: 每页可显示的最大记录数
